title: Legend of K-1: Grand Prix '96
native_title: レジェンド・オブＫ－１ ～グラン・プリ’９６～
overview: Legend of K-1 Grand Prix '96 is a multimedia database of the 1996 K-1 Grand Prix, produced with the cooperation of Seidokaikan and the K-1 Grand Prix office. It is not a fighting game: it is an interactive gallery for one player, presenting the tournament and its fighters on the Sega Saturn.
